codelists.name: RestrictionTypeValue
codelists.label: Restriction Type
codelists.definition: Possible restrictions on vehicles that can access a transport element.

values.label: maximum double axle weight
values.definition: The maximum weight per double axle of a vehicle allowed at a transport element.

values.label: maximum draught
values.definition: The maximum draught of a vehicle allowed on a transport element.

values.label: maximum flight level
values.definition: The maximum flight level allowed for a vehicle at a transport element.

values.label: maximum height
values.definition: The maximum height of a vehicle which can pass under another object.

values.label: maximum length
values.definition: The maximum length of a vehicle allowed at a transport element.

values.label: maximum single axle weight
values.definition: The maximum weight per single axle of a vehicle allowed at a transport element.

values.label: maximum total weight
values.definition: The maximum total weight of a vehicle allowed at a transport element.

values.label: maximum triple axle weight
values.definition: The maximum weight per triple axle of a vehicle allowed at a transport element.

values.label: maximum width
values.definition: The maximum width of a vehicle allowed on a transport element.

values.label: minimum flight level
values.definition: The minimum flight level allowed for a vehicle at a transport element.

codelists.name: AccessRestrictionValue
codelists.label: Access Restriction
codelists.definition: Types of access restrictions for a transport element.

values.label: forbidden legally
values.definition: Access to the transport element is forbidden by law.

values.label: physically impossible
values.definition: Access to the transport element is physically impossible due to the presence of barriers or other physical obstacles.

values.label: private
values.definition: Access to the transport element is restricted because it is privately owned.

values.label: public access
values.definition: The transport element is open to public access.

values.label: seasonal
values.definition: Access to the transport element depends on the season.

values.label: toll
values.definition: Access to the transport element is subject to toll.

codelists.name: TransportTypeValue
codelists.label: Transport type
codelists.definition: Possible types on transport networks.

values.label: road
values.definition: The transport network consists of transport by road

values.label: air
values.definition: The transport network consists of transport by air

values.label: rail
values.definition: The transport network consists of transport by rail

values.label: water
values.definition: The transport network consists of transport by water

values.label: cable
values.definition: The transport network consists of transport by cable

codelists.name: AreaConditionValue
codelists.label: Area Condition
codelists.definition: Speed limit restriction depending on the area.

values.label: in national park
values.definition: Speed limit restriction inside national park.

values.label: inside cities
values.definition: Speed limit restriction inside cities.

values.label: near railroad crossing
values.definition: Speed limit restriction near rail road crossing.

values.label: near school
values.definition: Speed limit restriction near school.

values.label: outside cities
values.definition: Speed limit restriction outside cities.

values.label: traffic calming area
values.definition: Speed limit restriction in traffic calming area.

codelists.name: FormOfRoadNodeValue
codelists.label: Form Of Road Node
codelists.definition: Functions of road nodes.

values.label: enclosed traffic area
values.definition: The road node is situated inside and/or represents an enclosed traffic area. A traffic area is an area with no internal structure of legally defined driving directions. At least two roads are connected to the area.

values.label: junction
values.definition: Road node where three or more road links connect.

values.label: level crossing
values.definition: A road node where the road network is a crossed by a railway at the same level.

values.label: pseudo node
values.definition: Exactly two road links connect to the road node.

values.label: road end
values.definition: Only one road link connects to the road node. It signifies the end of a road.

values.label: road service area
values.definition: Surface annexed to a road and devoted to offer particular services for it.

values.label: roundabout
values.definition: The road node represents or is a part of a roundabout. A roundabout is a road which forms a ring on which traffic travelling in only one direction is allowed.

values.label: traffic square
values.definition: Area (partly) enclosed by roads which is used for non-traffic purposes and which is not a roundabout.

codelists.name: RoadSurfaceCategoryValue
codelists.label: Road Surface Category
codelists.definition: Values to indicate whether a road is paved or not paved.

values.label: paved
values.definition: Road with a hard paved surface.

values.label: unpaved
values.definition: Road not paved.

codelists.name: SpeedLimitSourceValue
codelists.label: Speed Limit Source
codelists.definition: Possible sources for speed limits.

values.label: fixed traffic sign
values.definition: Source is a fixed traffic sign (site specific administrative order, explicit speed limit).

values.label: regulation
values.definition: Source is a regulation (national regulation, rule or 'implicit speed limit').

values.label: variable traffic sign
values.definition: Source is a variable traffic sign.

codelists.name: VehicleTypeValue
codelists.label: Vehicle Type
codelists.definition: Possible types of vehicles.

values.label: all vehicle
values.definition: Any vehicle, not including pedestrians.

values.label: bicycle
values.definition: A pedal-driven two-wheeled vehicle.

values.label: car with trailer
values.definition: A passenger car with an attached trailer.

values.label: delivery truck
values.definition: A truck vehicle of relatively small size, whose principal use is for delivery of goods and materials.

values.label: emergency vehicle
values.definition: A vehicle engaged in emergency response, including but not limited to police, ambulance and fire.

values.label: employee vehicle
values.definition: A vehicle operated by an employee of an organization that is used according to that organization's procedures.

values.label: facility vehicle
values.definition: A vehicle dedicated to a localized area within a private or restricted estate.

values.label: farm vehicle
values.definition: Vehicle commonly associated with farming activities.

values.label: high occupancy vehicle
values.definition: Vehicle populated with a number of occupants corresponding to (or exceeding) the specified minimum number of passengers.

values.label: light rail
values.definition: Train-like transport vehicle limited to a rail network within a limited area.

values.label: mail vehicle
values.definition: A vehicle that collects, carries or delivers mail.

values.label: military vehicle
values.definition: Vehicle authorized by a military authority.

values.label: moped
values.definition: Two or three wheeled vehicle equipped with internal combustion engine, with size less than 50 cc and maximum speed that does not exceed 45 km/h (28mph).

values.label: motorcycle
values.definition: Two or three wheeled vehicle equipped with internal combustion engine, with size more than 50 cc and maximum speed that does exceed 45 km/h (28mph).

values.label: passenger car
values.definition: A small vehicle designed for private transport of people.

values.label: pedestrian
values.definition: A person on foot.

values.label: private bus
values.definition: A vehicle designed for transport of large groups of people, privately owned or chartered.

values.label: public bus
values.definition: A vehicle designed for transport of large groups of people that is generally characterised by published routes and schedules.

values.label: residential vehicle
values.definition: A vehicle whose owner is resident (or a guest) of particular street or town area.

values.label: school bus
values.definition: Vehicle operated on behalf of a school to transport students.

values.label: snow chain equipped vehicle
values.definition: Any vehicle equipped with snow chains.

values.label: tanker
values.definition: A truck with more than two axles used to transport liquid or gas loads in bulk.

values.label: taxi
values.definition: A vehicle licensed for hire usually fitted with a meter.

values.label: transport truck
values.definition: A truck vehicle for long range transport of goods.

values.label: trolley bus
values.definition: A bus-like mass transport vehicle hooked up to an electrical network for power supply.

values.label: vehicle for disabled person
values.definition: A vehicle with supporting identification that designates a vehicle for disabled persons.

values.label: vehicle with explosive load
values.definition: Vehicle transporting explosive cargo.

values.label: vehicle with other dangerous load
values.definition: Vehicle transporting dangerous cargo other than explosive or water-polluting loads.

values.label: vehicle with water polluting load
values.definition: Vehicle transporting water-polluting cargo.

codelists.name: WeatherConditionValue
codelists.label: Weather Condition
codelists.definition: Values to indicate weather conditions that affect speed limits.

values.label: fog
values.definition: Speed applies when fog is present.

values.label: ice
values.definition: Speed applies when ice is present.

values.label: rain
values.definition: Speed applies when rain is present.

values.label: smog
values.definition: Speed applies when a certain amount of smog is present.

values.label: snow
values.definition: Speed applies when snow is present.

codelists.name: FormOfWayValue
codelists.label: Form Of Way
codelists.definition: Classification based on the physical properties of the road link.

values.label: bicycle road
values.definition: Road where bicycles are the only vehicles allowed.

values.label: dual carriageway
values.definition: Road with physically separated carriageways regardless of the number of lanes, which is not a motorway or a freeway.

values.label: entrance or exit car park
values.definition: Road specially designed to enter or to leave a parking area.

values.label: entrance or exit service
values.definition: Road used only to enter or to leave a service.

values.label: freeway
values.definition: Road having no single level crossings with other roads.

values.label: motorway
values.definition: Road to which regulations will normally apply with regards to entry and use. It has two or more mostly physically separated carriageways and no single level-crossings.

values.label: pedestrian zone
values.definition: Area with a road network which is especially designed for use by pedestrians.

values.label: service road
values.definition: Road running parallel to, and designed to connect, a road with a relatively high connectivity function with roads with a lower connectivity function.

values.label: single carriageway
values.definition: Road where the traffic is not separated by any physical object.

values.label: slip road
values.definition: Road especially designed to enter or exit another road.

values.label: tractor road
values.definition: Arranged road only usable for a tractor (farm vehicle or forest machine) or terrain vehicle (a vehicle with higher ground clearance, big wheels and 4 wheel drive).

values.label: walkway
values.definition: Road reserved for pedestrian use and closed for regular vehicular use by a physically barrier.

codelists.name: RoadServiceTypeValue
codelists.label: Road Service Type
codelists.definition: Types of road service areas.

values.label: bus station
values.definition: The road service is a bus stop.

values.label: parking
values.definition: The road service area is a parking facility.

values.label: rest area
values.definition: The road service is a rest area.

values.label: toll
values.definition: Area that provides toll services such as ticket dispensers or toll payment services.

codelists.name: ServiceFacilityValue
codelists.label: Service Facility
codelists.definition: Possible service facilities available at a road service area.

values.label: drinks
values.definition: Drinks are available.

values.label: food
values.definition: Food is available.

values.label: fuel
values.definition: Fuel is available.

values.label: picnic area
values.definition: A picnic area is present.

values.label: playground
values.definition: A playground area is present.

values.label: shop
values.definition: A shop is present.

values.label: toilets
values.definition: Toilets are present.

codelists.name: MinMaxLaneValue
codelists.label: Minimum or maximum track number
codelists.definition: Values to indicate whether number of lanes are counted as the maximum, minimum or average number.

values.label: maximum
values.definition: The number of lanes is the maximum value for a given part of the road network

values.label: average
values.definition: The number of lanes is the average value for a given part of the road network

values.label: minimum
values.definition: The number of lanes is the minimum value for a given part of the road network

codelists.name: SpeedLimitMinMaxValue
codelists.label: Nature of speed limit
codelists.definition: Possible values to indicate the nature of a speed limit.

values.label: recommendedMinimum
values.definition: Speed limit is a recommended minimum value

values.label: recommendedMaximum
values.definition: Speed limit is a recommended maximum value

values.label: maximum
values.definition: Speed limit is a maximum value

values.label: minimum
values.definition: Speed limit is a minimum value

codelists.name: FunctionalRoadClassValue
codelists.label: Functional road class
codelists.definition: Values for the functional road classification. This classification is based on the importance of the role that the road performs in the road network.

values.label: fourthClass
values.definition: The fifth most important roads in a given network

values.label: thirdClass
values.definition: The fourth most important roads in a given network

values.label: seventhClass
values.definition: The eighth most important roads in a given network

values.label: eighthClass
values.definition: The ninth most important roads in a given network

values.label: mainRoad
values.definition: The most important roads in a given network

values.label: firstClass
values.definition: The second most important roads in a given network

values.label: ninthClass
values.definition: The least important roads in a given network

values.label: secondClass
values.definition: The third most important roads in a given network

values.label: fifthClass
values.definition: The sixth most important roads in a given network

values.label: sixthClass
values.definition: The seventh most important roads in a given network

codelists.name: FormOfRailwayNodeValue
codelists.label: Form Of Railway Node
codelists.definition: The possible functions of a railway node within the railway network.

values.label: railway end
values.definition: Only one railway link connects to the railway node. It signifies the end of a railway line.

values.label: railway stop
values.definition: A place in the railway network where trains stop to load/unload cargo or to let passengers get on and off the train.

values.label: level Crossing
values.definition: A railway node where the railway network is a crossed by a road at the same level.

values.label: junction
values.definition: A railway node where the railway network has a mechanism consisting on a railroad track with two movable rails and the necessary connections, which let vehicles turn from one track to another.

values.label: pseudo node
values.definition: A railway node which represents a point where one or more attributes of the railway links connected to it change their value, or a point necessary to describe the geometry of the network.

codelists.name: RailwayTypeValue
codelists.label: Railway Type
codelists.definition: The possible types of railway transport.

values.label: cog railway
values.definition: A railway transport which allows the vehicles to operate on steep gradients, consisting of a railway provided with a toothed rack rail (usually between the running rails) where vehicles are fitted with one or more cog wheels or pinions that mesh with this rack rail.

values.label: funicular
values.definition: A railway transport consisting of a cable attached to a vehicle on rails which moves them up and down a very steep slope. Where possible the ascending and descending vehicles counterbalance each other.

values.label: magnetic levitation
values.definition: A railway transport based on a single rail which acts as guideway of a vehicle and supports it by means of a magnetic levitation mechanism.

values.label: metro
values.definition: An urban railway transport system used in large urban areas, which runs on a separate track from other transport systems, is usually electrically powered and in some cases runs under ground.

values.label: monorail
values.definition: A railway transport based on a single rail which acts as both its only support and guideway.

values.label: suspended rail
values.definition: A railway transport based on a single rail, acting as both support and guideway, from which a vehicle is suspended to move along the railway.

values.label: train
values.definition: A railway transport usually consisting of two parallel rails on which a powered-vehicle or train machine pulls a connected series of vehicles to move them along the railway in order to transport freight or passengers from one destination to another.

values.label: tramway
values.definition: A railway transport system used in urban areas, which often runs at street level, sharing road space with motor traffic and pedestrians. Tramways are usually electrically powered.

codelists.name: RailwayUseValue
codelists.label: Railway Use
codelists.definition: The possible uses of railways.

values.label: cargo
values.definition: The use of railway is exclusively for cargo operations.

values.label: car shuttle
values.definition: The use of railway is exclusively to perform car shuttle transport.

values.label: mixed
values.definition: The use of railway is mixed. It is used to transport passengers and cargo.

values.label: passengers
values.definition: The use of railway is exclusively to transport passengers.

codelists.name: MinMaxTrackValue
codelists.label: Min Max track
codelists.definition: Values to indicate whether number of tracks are counted as the maximum, minimum or average number.

values.label: average
values.definition: The number of tracks is the average value for a given part of the railway network

values.label: minimum
values.definition: The number of tracks is the minimum value for a given part of the railway network

values.label: maximum
values.definition: The number of tracks is the maximum value for a given part of the railway network

codelists.name: TrackGaugeCategoryValue
codelists.label: Track Gauge category
codelists.definition: The possible categories of railways concerning its nominal track gauge.

values.label: narrow
values.definition: The nominal track gauge property is narrower than the standard one

values.label: broad
values.definition: The nominal track gauge property is broader than the standard one

values.label: standard
values.definition: The nominal track gauge property is equal to the European standard (1435 millimetres)

values.label: notApplicable
values.definition: The definition of a nominal track gauge property is not applicable to the type of railway transport

codelists.name: CablewayTypeValue
codelists.label: Cableway Type
codelists.definition: The possible types of cableway transport.

values.label: cabin cable car
values.definition: A cableway transport whose vehicles consist of a suspended cabin for carrying groups of people and/or goods inside it from one location to another.

values.label: chair lift
values.definition: A cableway transport whose vehicles consist of suspended chairs for carrying individuals or groups of people from one location to another via a steel cable or rope which is looped around two points.

values.label: ski tow
values.definition: A cableway transport for pulling skiers and snowboarders uphill.

codelists.name: FerryUseValue
codelists.label: Ferry Use
codelists.definition: Types of transport carried out by a ferry.

values.label: cars
values.definition: Ferry carries cars.

values.label: other
values.definition: Ferry carries others forms of transport than passengers, cars, trucks or trains.

values.label: passengers
values.definition: Ferry carries passengers.

values.label: train
values.definition: Ferry carries trains.

values.label: trucks
values.definition: Ferry carries trucks.

codelists.name: FormOfWaterwayNodeValue
codelists.label: Form Of Waterway Node
codelists.definition: Function of a Waterway Node in the water transport network.

values.label: junction fork
values.definition: Infrastructure elements where one vessel traffic flow crosses another vessel traffic flow or points where vessel traffic flows divide or come together.

values.label: lock complex
values.definition: Lock or group of locks, intended for raising and lowering boats between stretches of water of different levels on river and canal waterways.

values.label: movable bridge
values.definition: Bridge that can be raised or turned to allow the passage of ships.

values.label: ship lift
values.definition: A machine for transporting boats between water bodies at two different elevations, which is used as an alternative to the canal locks.

values.label: water terminal
values.definition: The location where goods are transhipped.

values.label: turning basin
values.definition: A place where a canal or narrow waterway is widened to allow boats to turn around.

codelists.name: CEMTClassValue
codelists.label: CEMT class
codelists.definition: Inland waterway classification according to CEMT (European Conference of Ministers of Transport) Resolution No 92/2.

values.label: VII
values.definition: Inland waterway belonging to CEMT-class VII, defined by the European Conference of Ministers of Transport, Resolution No.92/2 - Table 1

values.label: VIb
values.definition: Inland waterway belonging to CEMT-class VIb, defined by the European Conference of Ministers of Transport, Resolution No.92/2 - Table 1

values.label: I
values.definition: Inland waterway belonging to CEMT-class I, defined by the European Conference of Ministers of Transport, Resolution No.92/2 - Table 1

values.label: Vb
values.definition: Inland waterway belonging to CEMT-class Vb, defined by the European Conference of Ministers of Transport, Resolution No.92/2 - Table 1

values.label: VIc
values.definition: Inland waterway belonging to CEMT-class VIc, defined by the European Conference of Ministers of Transport, Resolution No.92/2 - Table 1

values.label: III
values.definition: Inland waterway belonging to CEMT-class III, defined by the European Conference of Ministers of Transport, Resolution No.92/2 - Table 1

values.label: II
values.definition: Inland waterway belonging to CEMT-class II, defined by the European Conference of Ministers of Transport, Resolution No.92/2 - Table 1

values.label: Va
values.definition: Inland waterway belonging to CEMT-class Va, defined by the European Conference of Ministers of Transport, Resolution No.92/2 - Table 1

values.label: VIa
values.definition: Inland waterway belonging to CEMT-class VIa, defined by the European Conference of Ministers of Transport, Resolution No.92/2 - Table 1

values.label: IV
values.definition: Inland waterway belonging to CEMT-class IV, defined by the European Conference of Ministers of Transport, Resolution No.92/2 - Table 1

codelists.name: AerodromeCategoryValue
codelists.label: Aerodrome Category
codelists.definition: Aerodrome possible categories concerning the scope and importance of the air traffic services offered from and to it.

values.label: domestic national
values.definition: Aerodrome serving domestic national air traffic services.

values.label: domestic regional
values.definition: Aerodrome serving domestic regional air traffic services.

values.label: international
values.definition: Aerodrome serving international air traffic services.

codelists.name: AerodromeTypeValue
codelists.label: Aerodrome Type
codelists.definition: A code specifying whether a particular entity occurrence is an Aerodrome or a Heliport.

values.label: aerodrome heliport
values.definition: Aerodrome with heliport landing area.

values.label: aerodrome only
values.definition: Aerodrome only.

values.label: heliport only
values.definition: Heliport only.

values.label: landing site
values.definition: Landing site.

codelists.name: AirRouteLinkClassValue
codelists.label: Air Route Link Class
codelists.definition: The type of the route from the navigation point of view.
codelists.description:
SOURCE [CodeRouteNavigationType - AIXM5.0].

NOTE These values enumerate the possible usages of a AirRouteLink.

EXAMPLES Conventional, RNAV.

values.label: conventional
values.definition: Conventional navigation route: An air route which does neither use Area Navigation nor TACAN navigation for air traffic services.

values.label: RNAV
values.definition: Area navigation route: An air route which uses Area Navigation (RNAV) for air traffic services.

values.label: TACAN
values.definition: TACAN route: An air route which uses TACAN Navigation for air traffic services.

codelists.name: AirRouteTypeValue
codelists.label: Air Route Type
codelists.definition: The route classification as ATS route or North Atlantic Tracks.

values.label: ATS
values.definition: ATS Route as described in ICAO Annex 11.

values.label: NAT
values.definition: North Atlantic Track (part of Organized Track System).

codelists.name: AirspaceAreaTypeValue
codelists.label: Airspace Area Type
codelists.definition: Recognised types of Airspace.

values.label: Airport Traffic Zone
values.definition: Airspace of defined dimensions established around an airport for the protection of airport traffic.

values.label: control area
values.definition: A controlled airspace extending upwards from a specified limit above the earth.

values.label: control zone
values.definition: A controlled airspace extending upwards from the surface of the earth to a specified upper limit.

values.label: Danger area
values.definition: Danger area. Airspace of defined dimensions within which activities dangerous to the flight of aircraft may exist at specified times.

values.label: Flight Information Region
values.definition: Airspace of defined dimensions within which flight information service and alerting service are provided. Might, for example, be used if service provided by more than one unit.

values.label: Prohibited area
values.definition: Prohibited area. Airspace of defined dimensions, above the land areas or territorial waters of a State, within which the flight of aircraft is prohibited.

values.label: Restricted area
values.definition: Restricted area. Airspace of defined dimensions, above the land areas or territorial waters of a State, within which the flight of aircraft is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.

values.label: terminal control area
values.definition: Control area normally established at the confluence of ATS routes in the vicinity of one or more major aerodromes. Mainly used in Europe under the Flexible Use of Airspace concept.

values.label: Upper flight Information Region
values.definition: An upper airspace of defined dimensions within which flight information service and alerting service are provided. Each state determines its definition for upper airspace.

codelists.name: AirUseRestrictionValue
codelists.label: Air Use Restriction
codelists.definition: The use restrictions for an air network object.

values.label: reserved for military
values.definition: The air network object is exclusively for military use.

values.label: temporal restrictions
values.definition: The temporal restrictions apply to the use of the air network object.

codelists.name: NavaidTypeValue
codelists.label: Navaid Type
codelists.definition: Types of Navaid Services.

values.label: DME
values.definition: Distance Measuring Equipment.

values.label: ILS
values.definition: Instrument Landing System.

values.label: ILS-DME
values.definition: ILS with collocated DME.

values.label: LOC
values.definition: Localizer.

values.label: LOC-DME
values.definition: LOC and DME collocated.

values.label: MKR
values.definition: Marker Beacon.

values.label: MLS
values.definition: Microwave Landing System.

values.label: MLS-DME
values.definition: MLS with collocated DME.

values.label: NDB
values.definition: Non-Directional Radio Beacon.

values.label: NDB-DME
values.definition: NDB and DME collocated.

values.label: NDB-MKR
values.definition: Non-Directional Radio Beacon and Marker Beacon.

values.label: TACAN
values.definition: Tactical Air Navigation Beacon.

values.label: TLS
values.definition: Transponder Landing System.

values.label: VOR
values.definition: VHF Omnidirectional Radio Range.

values.label: VOR-DME
values.definition: VOR and DME collocated.

values.label: VORTAC
values.definition: VOR and TACAN collocated.

codelists.name: PointRoleValue
codelists.label: Point Role
codelists.definition: Role of the Runway Centreline Point.

values.label: end
values.definition: Physical end of a runway direction.

values.label: mid
values.definition: The mid point of the runway.

values.label: start
values.definition: Physical start of a runway direction.

values.label: threshold
values.definition: The beginning of that portion of the runway usable for landing.

codelists.name: RunwayTypeValue
codelists.label: Runway Type
codelists.definition: A code that makes a distinction between runways for airplanes and FATO for helicopters.

values.label: FATO
values.definition: Final Approach and Take Off Area for helicopters.

values.label: runway
values.definition: Runway for airplanes.

codelists.name: SurfaceCompositionValue
codelists.label: Surface Composition
codelists.definition: A code indicating the composition of a surface.

values.label: asphalt
values.definition: Surface made of an asphalt layer.

values.label: concrete
values.definition: Surface made of a concrete layer.

values.label: grass
values.definition: Surface consisting of a grass layer.

codelists.name: RoadPartValue
codelists.label: Road Part
codelists.definition: Indication to which part of a road the value of a measurement applies.

values.label: carriageway
values.definition: The part of a road which is reserved for traffic.

values.label: paved surface
values.definition: The part of the road which is paved.
